name: com.lingkyn.audio.core
description: Engine-light audio intent substrate: stable event, bus, snapshot, anchor, and parameter identity with a canonical form, an immutable declared mix graph, typed parameter contracts (float range, bool, enumerated set) with fail-closed rejection, spatial attachment intents that reference an anchor id, deterministic immutable audio state produced by intent sequences, and structured results with stable failure codes.

samples.description: Domain-only mix graph, parameter contracts, anchor attachment, snapshot transition, and a replayed intent sequence; needs no scene.
